questions.prompt: Where would the following sentence best be placed? “The goal was to shorten waiting time without changing the menu.”

choices.A: After sentence 2
choices.B: After sentence 5
choices.C: Before sentence 1
choices.D: After sentence 8

questions.correctAnswer: After sentence 2
questions.explanation: The sentence states the goal immediately after the original problem and before the new system is introduced.
questions.stimulusText: (1) At Jefferson Middle School, students once formed one long line to buy lunch. (2) The line often stretched across the cafeteria, making it difficult for students to reach tables. (3) The school tested a new system with two serving stations offering the same main choices. (4) During the first week, staff members recorded how long students waited at each station. (5) Average waiting time fell, although one station became crowded whenever students entered through the nearest door. (6) Staff members then placed a sign directing some students toward the second station. (7) The adjustment did not eliminate every delay. (8) It showed that observing how people actually use a system can reveal simple ways to improve it.

questions.prompt: Which revision of sentence 7 best strengthens the conclusion?

choices.A: The adjustment was an adjustment that changed some things about delays.
choices.B: Delays existed, and the cafeteria had tables and serving stations.
choices.C: The adjustment did not eliminate every delay, but it reduced the crowding that the staff had observed.
choices.D: Every delay disappeared immediately after the sign was placed.

questions.correctAnswer: The adjustment did not eliminate every delay, but it reduced the crowding that the staff had observed.
questions.explanation: This revision connects the adjustment to a specific result and leads logically into the concluding idea.
